input.summary: Add assignment mechanics to Section 10.3: Company free to assign to affiliates/successors, HDI assignment only with our consent and never to a competitor, no HDI termination right on our change of control.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 10.3 only binds successors and assigns; it does not restrain HDI from assigning the Agreement, including to a competitor of ours. We have added our standard position: we may assign to an affiliate or to a successor by merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets without consent and no change of control of ours gives HDI a termination right, while HDI may assign only with our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and never to a competitor.

ops.text: The Company may assign this Agreement, without HDI's consent, to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all of its assets, and no change of control of the Company shall give HDI any right to terminate this Agreement. HDI may not assign this Agreement without the Company's consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld, and may in no event assign this Agreement to a competitor of the Company.
